Edge Of Extinction is a strategic Tower Defence game set in the year 2086. An apocalypse has ravaged Earth, leaving most of humanity dead. 

Use any of the 50 unique towers to challenge the armies from over 20 modes!  Can you stop humanity's seemingly inevitable extinction? It is your duty to exterminate all beings that threaten humanity.  Slay the gods, and bring humanity from the Edge of Extinction.

Edge of Extinction Tower Defence is a very experimental game inspired by DOOM, Resident Evil, Kindergarten, Star Wars, Tower Blitz, and Call of Duty Advanced Warfare. Expect unexpected features.

Note: This game is in an early beta stage so EXPECT BUGS. 

Official release: June 28 2024
